Lower Resistance
(Abjuration)

Level: 5
Range: 40 ft.
Duration: 9 rounds + 1 round/level after 9th
Casting Time: 5
Area of Effect: 1 creature
Saving Throw: None

When cast upon a target creature, this spell will lower the Magic Resistance of this creature by 30% + 1% per level of the caster. There is no Saving Throw, and the target's Magic Resistance, if any, does not affect this spell. For example, if a creature has 60% Magic Resistance and this spell is cast on it by a 15th-level Mage, then the target's Magic Resistance would be lowered by 45% automatically. This effect is cumulative for each casting of this spell: If Lower Resistance was cast upon the same creature again, the creature's Magic Resistance would be 60% - 45% (initial casting) - 45% (current casting), which would leave the creature with 0% Magic Resistance. This spell will last until its duration expires and cannot be dispelled.
